summary: First Financial Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a regular quarterly dividend declaration of $0.56 per share payable July 15, 2026 to holders of record July 1, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer. No deal terms, premium, or structural changes are present. The filing contains no advisory, board recommendation, or mechanical notes relevant to special-situations analysis. As an ordinary dividend announcement, it does not meet the threshold for classification as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
